note: Provenance marker for the CircuitBoardGames/ClaudeCode maintainer agent's P2 vendor-sync drift check (docs/agents/maintainer.md Part A.6a). last_synced_upstream_sha was the fork's merge-base with true_upstream at seed time (2cda14e8, 2026-07-29); it now names the upstream tip actually integrated, and must be advanced in every true-upstream->fork sync PR. Seeded 2026-07-29, later than the other three forks (which were seeded per ClaudeCode issue #46) because this fork carried no divergence until then; see docs/agents/ua-fork-plan.md. This fork's divergence is PERMANENT and is not offered upstream, so sync upstream by integrating deliberately -- never blind-merge, and never rebase fork main, which would orphan the sha the hub records as last_vendored_sha. Check the incoming file set against the fork's own divergence first: a merge is safe only while that intersection is empty. One hazard specific to this fork: an upstream sync can move pnpm-lock.yaml, and a grammar re-resolving to a version with no musl prebuild turns a later install into a multi-MB g++ compile, so review lockfile changes in a sync PR rather than waving them through.
